title: Daily Devotional #61
paragraphs: As I read through Luke 17 today, I am struck by the importance of faith and gratitude in our lives. In the beginning of the chapter, Jesus tells his disciples that if they have faith as small as a mustard seed, they can tell a mulberry tree to be uprooted and planted in the sea, and it will obey them. It's a powerful reminder that even the tiniest bit of faith can move mountains.

Later in the chapter, Jesus heals ten lepers, but only one returns to thank him. The man is a Samaritan, an outsider in the eyes of the Jewish people, yet he is the only one who recognizes the miracle and expresses his gratitude. Jesus tells him, "Rise and go; your faith has made you well."

These stories remind me that faith and gratitude go hand in hand. When we have faith, we trust that you are with us always, even in the most challenging of times. And when we express our gratitude for your blessings, we open ourselves up to even more blessings and opportunities to grow in our faith.

Lord, I pray that you help me cultivate a stronger faith and deeper gratitude in my life. Help me to remember that even when my faith feels small, it has the power to move mountains. And help me to express my gratitude every day, whether in prayer or in my interactions with others.
Thank you for the many blessings in my life, and for the ways you continue to guide and support me each day. May my faith and gratitude be a reflection of your love and grace.
